children: Control Empresarial De Capitales S.A. De C.V., a 10% owner, reported sales of Talos Energy common shares in three transactions on 2026-10-08, 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12. The transactions were reported as sales with weighted average per-share prices of $17.031, $17.0781 and $17.2517 for the respective trade dates. The total sale amount reported across the three transactions was $106,840,463. Following the reported transactions, the reporter directly owns 32,359,036 common shares.
